scenarios.description: Routine daily uploads by a human administrator over 20 days
Steady scheduled lifecycle deletion at 02:00 by an automation role
Scheduled expiry deletion of recovery points by the backup automation role
Burst modification of 40 existing objects within 80 minutes
Four batched DeleteObjects calls removing 80 objects across 3 buckets
Versioned-bucket scrubbing: 60 version deletions in 15 minutes
12 EBS snapshot deletions across 2 regions within an hour
Recovery-point deletion across two vaults within 30 minutes
16 protection-degrading actions across buckets and backup vaults
70 same-prefix rewrites with new encryption keys in 20 minutes
Routine activity followed by a destructive burst (overlapping actors)
Malformed records: missing/invalid required fields and wrong types
Valid records with absent actor/region/account/network fields
